iir_filter.docs:
Set up an Infinite Impulse Response filter to increase accuracy. One of `OFF`, `2x`, `4x`, `16x`, `32`, `64x`, `128x`. Defaults to `OFF`.

*See also: [BMP388 / BMP390 Temperature+Pressure Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bmp3xx#configuration-variables)*

oversampling.docs:
The oversampling parameter for the temperature sensor. See [Oversampling Options](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bmp3xx#bmp3xx-oversampling).
